copy.title: Comp line
copy.body: Masters of Scale meets My First Million. The founder access and craft of the first, with the candid, business-minded conversation of the second, aimed at one story: the company that failed first.

copy.author: llm

copy.title: Network & sponsor pitch
copy.body: First Failure is a weekly podcast in which a well-known founder tells the full story of the startup that failed before the one that worked. Its closest comps by Qloo affinity are Masters of Scale (fit 0.99, Mid-list, Top 2%) and My First Million (fit 0.98, Mid-list, Top 3%), with All-In with Chamath, Jason, Sacks & Friedberg and Noah Kagan Presents close behind. The audience is the one that already listens to How I Built This with Guy Raz, This Week in Startups, Acquired and Founders. The Tim Ferriss Show (Breakout, Top 0.43%) shows how large this lane can get. The listeners skew male and over-index at 45–54. Their tastes run to business strategies, technology and biography. Adjacent channels include Asana, Salesforce and GitHub, and people such as Marc Andreessen, Ben Horowitz and Brian Chesky, which suggests natural sponsor and guest territory. This is aggregate taste data, not a forecast. Strongest markets are Las Vegas and Los Angeles, with Boise, El Paso and Anchorage as hidden gems.
copy.hint: Comps and audience for a network, guest or sponsor pitch.
copy.author: llm

copy.title: Who it's for
copy.body: The audience overlaps with How I Built This with Guy Raz, This Week in Startups, Acquired and Founders. It skews male (+0.55) and over-indexes at 45–54 (+0.42), while 35–44 and 55+ sit below average. Taste descriptors include biography, business strategies, technology and existential reflection, so these listeners want the full narrative and what the founder took from it. The same audience also favors Free Solo, The Dawn Wall and Meru, films about high-stakes attempts, and How to Lead: Wisdom from the World's Greatest CEOs, Founders, and Game Changers and How Innovation Works: Serendipity, Energy and the Saving of Time among books. Las Vegas and Los Angeles are strongholds.

kit.headline: Masters of Scale and My First Million sit closest to the How I Built This with Guy Raz, This Week in Startups, Acquired and Founders audience, and Masters of Scale and My First Million have no weekly show built only on the failure before the win.
kit.summary: First Failure sits in the founder-story lane that How I Built This with Guy Raz, This Week in Startups, Acquired and Founders listeners already share, with Masters of Scale and My First Million as the closest comps by fit. The audience skews male and over-indexes at 45–54, so lead with the depth of the story rather than startup tips. Use The Tim Ferriss Show as the size reference for Breakout ambition, and Las Vegas and Los Angeles as the strongholds to target first.
notes: Fit and size come from Qloo affinity and popularity percentiles. They describe aggregate taste, not sales or any individual.
